title: Strategic account voice-tiering and fractional delivery scheduler
creator: Asha Rao
description:
Problem: As Redwood grows its enterprise base, product teams are overloaded with ad-hoc top-account asks and VIP escalations. Current intake is manual and inconsistent: different reps, account advocates, and solutions engineers escalate via email/Slack and expect prioritized roadmap slots. This creates unrealistic commitments, opaque decisions for customers, and uneven allocation across quarters.

Proposed solution: Build a structured 'Strategic Voice Tiering' layer in the intake flow that captures account signal, advocacy level, contractual commitments, and urgency, then translates that signal into a deterministic fractional delivery schedule (timeboxed micro-deliveries) with automated fallback policies. The feature includes:
- Intake form schema (Console + PM intake) with voice-level fields: advocacy_level, contract_tier, deployment_risk, regulatory_impact, blocked_customers_count.
- A scoring engine that combines quantitative signals (ARR, tickets, SLO breaches, contract clauses) and qualitative inputs (account advocate recommendation) to compute a priority score.
- Fractional delivery scheduler that maps priority bands to delivery cadence windows (e.g., P-Voice Tier A => 2-week sprint slot with 50% dedicated capacity for micro-work; Tier B => queued in 6-week window).
- Escalation fallback policies: model-variant fallback, cross-region reroute, and negotiated incremental scope (MVP + follow-up deliverables).
- Console UI: 'Strategic Requests' queue with visibility for GTM, CSMs, and Eng leads; decision timeline and audit log.

Goals: Reduce time-to-decision for top-account incoming asks to <= 5 business days; lower unplanned scope additions by 40%; increase transparency for customers and sales; provide clear SLA for commitments to be surfaced to contracts/legal.

Scope: Intake schema, scoring heuristics, scheduling engine (logic + API), Console queue UI, audit logs, metrics, playbook for customer communications. Integrations required: CRM (HubSpot/SF), Contracts repo, Support dashboard, and existing rollouts service.

Out of scope for initial launch: full automated delivery orchestration (we will surface scheduled slots and hand-off to Eng squads), on-prem deployment special-case workflows (later iteration).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form is available in Console and via PM intake link and captures required fields
Priority score computed within 2 seconds of submission and visible on request card
Scheduler allocates a tentative delivery window according to policy and notifies stakeholders
Escalation fallback options are surfaced when requested model/region capacity cannot be met
Audit log entries recorded for every decision and visible to Security/Legal reviewers
Runbook for CSMs and AE with templated responses and SLA commitments is published

rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Implement intake schema + scoring engine prototype behind feature flag; basic Console queue card (read-only)
Week 3-4: Wire up Scheduler API, add tentative slot assignment, enable notifications to CSM/AEs; run manual pilot with 3 strategic accounts
Week 5-6: Collect pilot feedback, refine scoring weights, add audit logging and contract references; train GTM stakeholders
Week 7: Gradual enablement for regional GTM teams, monitor metrics and rollback safety checks
metrics: Time-to-decision (business days) for strategic intake requests
Percent of top-account asks assigned a delivery slot within 5 business days
Number of scope changes post-slot assignment (target -40%)
Escalation recurrence rate for same account within 90 days
decision_log: 2026-03-11: Chose deterministic fractional delivery scheduling over full delivery promises to reduce overcommit risk (PM + Eng consensus).
2026-03-12: Decided to surface contract clauses in intake but not enforce automated billing adjustments (Legal requested a manual review).
2026-03-13: Design approved read-first Console card; detailed decision timeline added as a follow-up
notes: Risk: If scoring relies on stale CRM data, priority banding will be inaccurate. Mitigation: implement data freshness checks and a manual override flag for advocates.
Integration action: Assign ENG-10002 to stabilize Contracts API; coordinate with Sales Ops for mapped fields by 2026-03-20.
Follow-up: Build a debrief template for completed fractional deliveries to capture signal for Optimize and runtime performance tuning.
